title: Child Of Conflict
summary: "This book contains nine essays and two commentaries. All except two essays are on United States policy dealing with the Korean question between 1943 and 1953. Eight articles which dealt with the birth of a "child of conflict" are: "Introduction: The Course of Korean-American Relations, 1943- 1953" by .Bruce Cumings; "Diplomacy Delayed: The Atomic Bomb and the Division of Korea, 1945" by Mark Paul
